activity_summary: You came home to find the three already there, and the race they had run was only an argument. Susanna had carried the cloth, and the corner was still a corner. Joan put it aside until after the water. You gave them the river again as the middle of the afternoon, and not the whole of it. Anne sent you for your father's knife, and told you to bring it back. The book was going. The cloth was staying.
